swap.note: Cumulative host counters since boot, not deltas over the window. K8/K9 are not load-generated and are insensitive to swap pressure; recorded for schema conformance.

ceiling.reason: K8/K9 are artifact and startup properties, not load-generated figures. Rule 3 does not apply.

verdict_reason: K8: release binary 41.39 MB vs < 50 MB target. K9: worst-of-5 cold start 70 ms vs < 2000 ms target; measured as exec -> first successful GET /health on a fresh empty data dir, --dev (in-memory storage), no corpus. A cold start against a large on-disk corpus is a DIFFERENT measurement and is NOT graded here — it belongs to C8.
